question: How Can We Achieve World Peace?

answers.text: You have a mind, I have a mind You have money, I have money Everything, we have and the Environment, you have it
Every one of us has a human nature We feel that we are the best. But still we are nothing. Nothing. We need to go back to the nature
When you go to the mountain Looking to the mountain How much is it big? And you are nothing, you are that much
Each people are a different mentality You cannot, guide anyone But at least you can show him something Maybe he will think about it later
Some people in your mind will never leave
For that reason, let's go for our humanity
to understand how we can make the peace

'fB We just need to love one another and stop being hypocrites Because in our mouth, we are talking about peace But deep down, what we are doing our action does not reflect the peace that we did talk about
Because this is politics How will I stop this one[war]?
Making money and good life that will be my peace
I just want to be in a quite place I like to stay alone That's how I can get peace
I think we should, keep good relations with, other countries So then, we can keep peace everywhere
World Peace? -How do we get it? Chilling with friends Make a call with my family Something. Something.
